steps: Confirm histology (non-caseating granulomas) and EXCLUDE TB/infection/lymphoma first.
Treat if organ-threatening (cardiac, neuro, eye, progressive lung, hypercalcaemia): corticosteroids first-line.
Screen for cardiac and ocular involvement; monitor calcium.

confirm: Multisystem granulomatous disease — bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy, lung infiltrates ± skin/eye/cardiac involvement; non-caseating granulomas on biopsy (exclude TB).
